h1: Testing and evaluation for agents on real cases
overview: You cannot judge an agent from one good demo. We gather real cases from your work, write what a correct result looks like, run the agent on all of them and score the output. You get a plain report showing how often it is right, where it fails and which fixes would help most. We can retest after changes so you see whether it improved.

faq: Where do the test cases come from?
From your real work, such as past tickets, emails or documents, with names masked if needed. If you have few examples, we help write realistic ones and mark them as made-up.
Will you fix the problems you find?
Fixes are listed and ranked in the report. Small fixes to our own builds are covered by revisions. Larger rework on other builders' agents can be quoted separately.
Can you test an agent you did not build?
Usually yes, if we can run it or send it inputs and read its outputs. We confirm access before you order and tell you if the agent cannot be tested safely.
Does a good score mean it is safe to run alone?
It means it did well on those cases. New situations can still go wrong, so we advise limits, approvals and monitoring alongside testing, especially for risky actions.
